capabilities: Display notes in alphanumeric order by their id property in a sidebar panel
Create new notes continuing a sequence or branching into a subsequence
Set an existing note's ID based on another note via a search modal
Show a table of contents view of top-level or toc-marked notes
Fuzzy search notes by title, ID, or table-of-contents title
extras: README links to an external introductory article on Folgezettel for a deeper explanation, and mentions the author's other plugins Reader Mode and Yesterday.
problem: Obsidian orders notes by filename, so users who want structured ID sequences must clutter filenames with numbers or lack a dedicated view for hierarchical note ordering.
summary: Sidebar panel that orders notes by an id property, enabling Folgezettel-style sequences, cluster views, a table of contents, and sequence-based note creation.
